lines:
sequenceDiagram
participant S as Graph Scheduler
participant N as Node Runtime
participant G as Worker Core Gateway
participant L as Core Chat Lifecycle
participant B as Core Invocation Broker
participant A as Core Authority Engine
participant C as Core Event Committer
participant H as Capability Host
participant P as Attempt Policy
participant X as Context Store

S->>G: WorkerProposalV1 transition and NodeStarted with worker sequence n
G->>L: generation and snapshot fenced proposal n
L->>C: commit transition and node start at expected Chat version
C-->>G: CoreCommittedAckV1 cursor n
G-->>S: durable predecessor acknowledged
S->>N: Execute NodeInputEnvelopeV1
N-->>S: NeedCapability with typed request draft
S->>G: InvocationProposalV1 stable invocation node attempt authority and budget refs
G->>B: propose invocation over framed IPC
B->>C: commit InvocationProposedV1
C-->>B: durable proposal
B->>A: evaluate against frozen authority manifest
A-->>B: permit deny or approval required
alt denied or approval rejected
  B->>C: commit denied outcome
  C-->>B: durable outcome
  B-->>G: committed CapabilityOutcomeV1 denied
else permitted or explicitly approved
  B->>C: commit authorization and dispatch outbox
  C-->>B: durable authorization
  B->>H: ApprovedInvocationEnvelopeV1
  H-->>B: normalized acceptance progress and result
  B->>C: commit semantic result usage artifacts and settlement
  C-->>B: durable settled outcome
  B-->>G: committed CapabilityOutcomeV1
end
G-->>S: deliver outcome once at committed cursor
S->>P: DecideAttempt with frozen policy and outcome class
alt success
  S->>X: Revise base revision with typed result and provenance
  X-->>S: new immutable revision ID
  S->>G: WorkerProposalV1 NodeCompleted and next transition
  G->>L: proposal with result evidence and checkpoint boundary
  L->>C: commit semantic events checkpoint ref and control outbox
  C-->>G: CoreCommittedAckV1 advances cursor
else definite not started and retry eligible
  P-->>S: RetryWithNewAttempt within remaining limits
else outcome uncertain for possible side effect
  P-->>S: RequireUserDecision or follow declared non-repeating path
end
Note over S,H: The worker has no direct host channel and never authorizes or dispatches work
Note over B,G: A potentially side-effecting uncertain outcome is not converted into an ordinary worker retry
